newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq Dec short interest aggregated shrs higher.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq Dec short interest aggregated shrs higher.

text.p: Short interest in 4,085 securities on the Nasdaq National Market aggregated 1,310,247,885 shares by December 15, compared to 1,259,221,592 shares in 4,051 issues for November, the exchange said Thursday.
Nasdaq said the December short interest represented 2.60 days' average daily share volume for the period against 2.51 days in November.
It said short interest in 1,401 SmallCap Market securities aggregated 56,122,061 shares for December compared to 53,610,861 shares in 1,425 securities for November.
Nasdaq said the open short-interest positions it reported for each security reflect the total number of shares sold short.
